high_level_description: The image is a weather map showing precipitation levels across parts of India. The map uses a color gradient to indicate the intensity of rainfall, with darker shades representing higher rainfall amounts. The colors range from light blue (indicating lighter rainfall) to dark purple (indicating heavier rainfall). Key features on the map include: A prominent area of heavy rainfall (dark purple) extending along the eastern coast of India, particularly affecting regions like Odisha and West Bengal.
